risks.risk: The machine may not power on or have electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up to the home screen.

risks.risk: Print quality may be poor due to exhausted drums, fuser issues, or depleted toner.

risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full service and consumable replacement

risks.risk: High mechanical wear (high meter count) reducing the remaining lifespan.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Meter Count' or 'Counter' screen showing total pages printed.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit near end-of-life

risks.risk: Internal components or paper trays may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photos of all paper trays pulled out and the internal toner/drum compartment open.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and reaching the ready state.
Photo of the system counter/meter reading screen.
Photo of a recent color test print or configuration page.
Photos of the internal compartments and all paper trays open.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos. However, as it is shown powered off in a dusty environment, it must be priced at the worst-case scenario of a non-functional unit until operational proof is provided.
